note: Dated events for the timeline. Each entry is a Kami3D summary of the cited source - the summary text is ours (CC0), the source is linked. No range polygon is implied by an event.
attribution: Kami3D timeline summaries, citing the linked sources.

events.title: Megalodon dies out
events.summary: The last Otodus megalodon populations disappear, around 3.6 million years ago, as ocean temperatures fell and its prey moved to cooler water.

events.title: The end-Cretaceous extinction
events.summary: The Chicxulub impact ends the Cretaceous and, with it, the non-avian dinosaurs - including Tyrannosaurus rex.

events.title: Smilodon dies out
events.summary: Smilodon disappears at the end of the Pleistocene, after its large-bodied prey collapsed.

events.title: The last mammoths on Wrangel Island
events.summary: The final isolated population of woolly mammoths, on Wrangel Island, dies out about 4 000 years ago.

events.title: CITES signed
events.summary: The Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species is signed in Washington, creating the permit system that still governs trade in endangered species.

events.title: Project Tiger begins
events.summary: India launches Project Tiger, creating reserves that are still the backbone of tiger conservation.

events.title: Commercial whaling moratorium agreed
events.summary: The International Whaling Commission agrees a moratorium on commercial whaling, in force from the 1985-86 season.

events.title: International ivory trade banned
events.summary: CITES moves the African elephant to Appendix I, banning the international commercial ivory trade.

events.title: Wolves return to Yellowstone
events.summary: Fourteen wolves are released in Yellowstone National Park, the start of a reintroduction that reshaped the park's ecosystem.

events.title: Bald eagle leaves the endangered list
events.summary: The bald eagle is removed from the US endangered species list after decades of recovery, from a low of about 400 breeding pairs.

events.title: Cecil the lion is killed
events.summary: A tagged lion known as Cecil is shot outside Hwange National Park in Zimbabwe, setting off a global argument about trophy hunting.

events.title: Giraffes listed as Vulnerable
events.summary: The IUCN moves the giraffe from Least Concern to Vulnerable, citing a decline of around 40% over three decades.

events.title: The axolotl's canals keep shrinking
events.summary: The IUCN assessment keeps the axolotl at Critically Endangered, with urban expansion in Xochimilco and introduced fish as the main threats.

events.title: Three billion animals in the bushfires
events.summary: The 2019-20 Australian bushfire season is estimated to have affected three billion animals, including kangaroos, koalas and reptiles.

events.title: Giant panda downlisted to Vulnerable
events.summary: The IUCN moves the giant panda from Endangered to Vulnerable, crediting decades of habitat protection and bamboo forest recovery.

events.title: Migratory monarch listed as Endangered
events.summary: The IUCN lists the migratory monarch butterfly as Endangered, citing habitat loss and climate-driven extremes at its overwintering sites.

events.title: Emperor penguin listed as threatened
events.summary: The US Fish & Wildlife Service lists the emperor penguin as threatened under the Endangered Species Act, with sea-ice loss as the driving risk.

events.title: Lockdowns change what we see
events.summary: During the first COVID-19 lockdowns, wildlife was reported in unusually urban places - a reminder that observation effort, not only animal numbers, shapes the record.
events.source: Wikipedia: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on wildlife
